newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate eases, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate eases, baht firmer late.

text.p: Rising liquidity pushed the Thai overnight interbank rate down to 11.50-12.00 percent late on Thursday from 14.50 early in the morning and 14.50-15.00 late on Wednesday, dealers said.
Dealers said money supply eased after commercial banks met cash reserve requirements set by the central bank and as demand of market funds by finance companies eased.
Thai finance companies need to comply with the Bank of Thailand's cash reserve requirements every Thursday.
